review.status: Contract reviewed before implementation; target acceptance pending.

description: Enumerate all unordered point-index pairs within an inclusive Euclidean radius using a deterministic x sweep.
output_invariants: Strict lexicographic original-index pairs 0<=i<j<N, no duplicates/self pairs; fully detached. Empty input returns no pairs.

behavior.validation: Exact passive Object/null-prototype record; no classes, accessors, symbols, extras or coercion. Dense ordinary arrays with own data slots and no extras; proxies outside interchange. Point arrays contain finite binary64 pairs, length at most2147483647. Canonicalize accepted zero values. Validate all fields and correspondence in input-schema order before work checks, including empty/identity cases. No input mutation or aliasing; all output arrays and pairs detached.
behavior.work: After static validation charge N events before sorting/output; then one event per unordered pair whose rounded absolute x difference<=radius, including y/distance rejections. Charge candidate before y/hypot arithmetic. If next event exceeds maxWork, WORK_LIMIT, no partial result. Sorting/static validation are not budget events. O(N log N+C+K log K), O(N+K) storage; C may be N(N-1)/2 for vertical or dense points. Budget behavior depends on orientation.
behavior.algorithm: Sort indices by ascending point x with original index tie break (compare values, do not use subtraction as comparator). For each sorted index a visit subsequent sorted indices b ascending. Compute dx=x[b]-x[a]; if dx>radius break (positive infinity is an outside screen). Otherwise charge candidate; compute dy=abs(y[b]-y[a]); if dy>radius skip, including infinity. If radius==0 accept only exact x and y equality. Otherwise accept iff existing fdlibmHypot(dx,dy)<=radius; an infinite hypot is outside. Store [min(originalA,originalB),max(...)]. Sort output pairs lexicographically by integer indices.
behavior.numerics: Binary64 primitive rounding, no FMA, no epsilon. fdlibmHypot is the existing audited profile in packages/javascript/src/internal/fdlibm-hypot.js (including its subnormal correction). Topology compares exactly under that profile, not abstract exact-real geometry. Input numbers finite; subtraction/hypot infinity is allowed only as an outside screen.
behavior.environment: No RNG, clock, renderer, wrapping, domain, persistent index or hidden identity. Coordinate units arbitrary consistent Cartesian units; query independent of axis handedness.
behavior.native_surface: radiusPairs2D(input), RadiusPairs2DError from radius-pairs-2d.js and package index.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Carrier, shape or finite-domain failure before work.
errors.WORK_LIMIT: Next event exceeds maxWork, no partial output.
